resources.string: Microphone audio source tuned for voice communications. Built-in echo cancellation.
Records both sides of a phone calls. The raw audio, with phone tones.
Records only your side of a phone call (uplink).
Records only the other person side of a phone call (downlink).
Captures the final, combined audio exactly as it is sent to your speakers.
Capture audio from other apps, except those that restrict recording (respects app opt-out flags).
High-speed microphone mode designed for live music and real-time audio apps.
Captures audio directly from the device main microphone. Minor noise reduction.
Captures raw, natural microphone audio without any automatic filtering or enhancement.
Tuned for video recording, focusing on audio from the direction of the camera.
Microphone with processing tuned for speech recognition (reduced noise).
